criteria.text: The response concludes that the Distribution Agreement gives Konais exclusivity across the United States and Canada and through all wholesale remarketing channels, that this is far broader than the tri-state (New York, New Jersey, Connecticut) franchised-dealer scope recorded in the Side Letter, and that the Agreement's broader grant controls.
hints: franchised dealers in New York, New Jersey and Connecticut

criteria.text: The response locates the overbroad exclusivity issue in the Distribution Agreement's definition of Territory (Section 1) and/or Section 3.1.
For the overbroad exclusivity issue, the response explains why it matters to Laseisk and recommends a fix.

The response concludes that Laseisk's Section 9.3 right to end Konais's exclusivity for the Contract Year 1 volume shortfall expired on April 14, 2026, so the May 20, 2026 Amendment No. 1 reservation of rights does not preserve it.
The response locates the expired notice window issue in Amendment No. 1 (Recital B and/or Section 3) or in Distribution Agreement Section 9.3.
For the expired notice window issue, the response explains why it matters to Laseisk and recommends a fix.

The response concludes that Konais can assign the Distribution Agreement, including its exclusive appointment, without Laseisk's consent to any acquirer of its business, including a competitor of Laseisk.
The response locates the assignment issue in Distribution Agreement Section 16.2 and/or the Section 1 definition of Permitted Assignee.
For the assignment issue, the response explains why it matters to Laseisk and recommends a fix.
The response states that the Distribution Agreement's Effective Date is March 1, 2025.
The response is a memo that presents the issues as a list ordered by importance to the client, not as a clause-by-clause summary.
The response claims that Amendment No. 1's reservation of rights preserves Laseisk's right to convert Konais's appointment to non-exclusive for the Contract Year 1 shortfall.
The response claims that the Side Letter's tri-state franchised-dealer scope prevails over the Distribution Agreement's Territory and exclusivity grant.
